cause: The first built source image could not read the retained /opt/dwarf-fortress/raw directory under the configured UID. Native copy preflight failed before any game process or model call.
correction: Copy the native runtime assets from a named stage of the same immutable base into a derived layer owned by the configured UID/GID. Preserve modes and base image; do not run the game as root or grant broad permissions.
scope: Build the configured-user image and verify two paused native loads with original bounds and mandatory teardown. Not a model performance run.
